title: Conditional Gene Expression in Magnaporthe oryzae via Nitrate Reductase Promoter Replacement
author: Rahnama, King

steps.title: Amplify DNA fragments for promoter replacement
steps.instruction: Prepare a 50 µL PCR reaction for each fragment (LF, hph, pMoNIA1, RF) containing 25 µL Q5 High‑Fidelity 2× Master Mix, 5 µL DNA template (~10 ng/µL), 2.5 µL forward primer (10 µM), 2.5 µL reverse primer (10 µM), and 15 µL molecular water. Run the PCR with the following program: 98 °C 30 s initial denaturation; 32 cycles of 98 °C 10 s denaturation, annealing at the fragment‑specific temperature for 30 s, and extension at 72 °C (LF, hph, pMoNIA1 1 min 30 s; RF 2 min). Finish with a final extension at 72 °C for 2 min and hold at 4 °C. Verify product size on an agarose gel, purify each PCR product with AMPure XP beads, and quantify DNA concentration using a NanoDrop spectrophotometer.

substeps.instruction: Prepare PCR mix for each fragment
Run PCR cycling program
Check product size on agarose gel
Purify PCR products with AMPure XP beads
Quantify DNA with NanoDrop

steps.title: Linearize pMY200 vector with PmeI
steps.instruction: Digest the pMY200 plasmid with the blunt‑end restriction enzyme PmeI to cut between the T‑DNA left and right borders. Verify complete digestion by agarose gel electrophoresis and purify the linearized backbone using AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Digest pMY200 with PmeI
Run gel to confirm complete digestion
Purify linearized vector with AMPure XP beads

steps.title: Assemble construct via Gibson assembly
steps.instruction: Combine equimolar amounts of the purified LF, hph, pMoNIA1 promoter, RF fragments and the linearized pMY200 backbone with NEBuilder HiFi DNA Assembly Master Mix (New England Biolabs) following the manufacturer’s protocol. Assemble in the order: pMY200 backbone – LF – hph – pMoNIA1 – RF – pMY200 backbone. Incubate the assembly reaction at 50 °C for 30 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Mix fragments with HiFi DNA Assembly Master Mix
Incubate at 50 °C for 30 min

steps.title: Transform Gibson assembly into E. coli DH5α
steps.instruction: Introduce 2–5 µL of the Gibson assembly reaction into chemically competent E. coli DH5α cells. Plate transformed cells on LB agar containing kanamycin and incubate for 12–16 hours at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Add assembly to competent DH5α cells
Plate on LB + kanamycin
Incubate 12–16 h at 37 °C

steps.title: Select colonies and isolate plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Pick 20 kanamycin‑resistant colonies, inoculate each into LB liquid medium supplemented with kanamycin, and culture for 12–16 hours at 37 °C with shaking. Isolate plasmid DNA from these cultures using the Zyppy Plasmid Miniprep Kit (Zymo Research) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

substeps.instruction: Pick 20 colonies
Grow each in LB + kanamycin for 12–16 h
Perform miniprep with Zyppy kit

steps.title: Verify construct by digestion and sequencing
steps.instruction: Confirm the integrity of the isolated plasmid by restriction enzyme digestion and by full‑plasmid sequencing using Plasmidsaurus (Oxford Nanopore Technology). The verified construct is designated pMY200‑ProRC.

substeps.instruction: Digest plasmid to check fragment pattern
Submit plasmid for Nanopore sequencing
Confirm correct assembly and name construct pMY200‑ProRC

steps.title: Plate transformants on inducing and repressing media
steps.instruction: Transfer a small mycelial plug from each confirmed transformant (T1 and T2) onto two solid minimal‑medium plates: (i) Inducing medium – Minimal Medium supplemented with 7.14 g/L KNO₃; (ii) Repressing medium – Minimal Medium supplemented with 10.4 g/L glutamate. Include wild‑type M. oryzae on both plates as a control.

substeps.instruction: Prepare mycelial plugs from T1 and T2
Spot plugs onto inducing (KNO₃) plate
Spot plugs onto repressing (glutamate) plate
Spot wild‑type control onto both plates

steps.title: Incubate plates and document colony pigmentation
steps.instruction: Incubate all plates at 25 °C under continuous light for 5–7 days. After incubation, observe and record colony colour differences between inducing and repressing conditions, documenting representative phenotypes.

substeps.instruction: Incubate plates at 25 °C, continuous light, 5–7 days
Observe and record colony pigmentation

description: CRITICAL: To prevent contamination, all procedures involving fungal spores and cultures should be carried out in a sterile environment, such as a biosafety cabinet, using sterilized materials and equipment.
